headline: 11 Million US Students Now Learn in Solar-Powered Schools
meta_description: One in seven US students attends a solar-powered school, with buildings generating clean electricity and cutting energy costs.
summary_short: More than 11 million American children now study in solar-powered school buildings that generate clean electricity and reduce energy expenses.
body:
One in seven students in the United States now attends a school powered by solar energy. That means more than 11 million children learn, play, and grow in buildings generating their own clean electricity directly from the sun.

Beyond the environmental benefits, schools adopting solar technology are also cutting their energy costs significantly. The shift reflects a broader movement to make educational facilities more sustainable while freeing up budget resources for classrooms and students.

This widespread adoption shows how renewable energy has moved from niche innovation to practical infrastructure in American schools. What began as scattered pilot projects has scaled into a genuine transformation of how millions of young people experience their learning environment—surrounded by the tangible evidence that clean energy works.
